Overview

Taldykorgan is a city in Zhetysu with a population of 200,000. A city in southeastern Kazakhstan at the foot of the Dzungarian Alatau mountains, a center for agriculture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 255 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
